# SuperLightTUI

> Immediate-mode TUI library for Rust. One closure runs every frame; the library handles layout, diffing, and rendering. Designed for fast iteration and AI-assisted TUI code generation.

## Reading order for coding agents

- [Complete reference (single-file)](COMPLETE_REFERENCE.md): condensed full API. Start here for most tasks.
- [Quick start](QUICK_START.md): install, first app, closure mental model, mouse opt-in, shortcut ordering
- [AI guide](AI_GUIDE.md): common questions agents get wrong, implementation rules
- [Widgets](WIDGETS.md): categorized API catalog (50+ widgets, state types, runtime methods)
- [Patterns](PATTERNS.md): composition patterns, state ownership, screens, forms
- [Examples guide](EXAMPLES.md): the 29 runnable `cargo run --example` targets (8 tours + entry, feature, tool, and report binaries) and which source files each tour uses
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, frame lifecycle, layout pipeline
- [Design principles](DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md): API philosophy, immediate-mode rationale

## Core concepts

- The mouse is on by default in fullscreen runs: `MouseMode::Drag` locally (clicks, wheel, drags), `MouseMode::Click` over SSH/mosh; inline/static runs default to `MouseMode::Off`. Hover, tooltips and `group_hover_*` need `slt::run_with(slt::RunConfig::default().mouse_mode(slt::MouseMode::Hover), |ui| { ... })`. Focused buttons also activate with Enter / Space.
- Check global shortcuts (`ui.key('q')`) after rendering widgets: `key*` sees events not consumed so far, so a check placed before a focused `text_input` fires while the user types into it.

- [Run loop](ARCHITECTURE.md#frame-lifecycle): 8-stage per-frame pipeline
- [Immediate mode](DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md): no App trait, no Model/Update/View
- [Previous-frame feedback](ARCHITECTURE.md#one-frame-delay-feedback): why Response.rect is valid from frame 2
- [State ownership](PATTERNS.md): app state vs hooks vs widget state

## API surface

- [Crate root re-exports](../src/lib.rs): authoritative public API
- [Context runtime methods](../src/context/runtime.rs): use_state, use_memo, focus, interaction, error_boundary

### Component / state APIs

- `ui.provide(value, |ui| { ... })` — context injection, scoped to the closure body
- `ui.use_context::<T>()` — read provided context (panics if no `T` is in scope)
- `ui.try_use_context::<T>()` — read provided context, returns `Option<&T>` (safe form)
- `ui.use_state_named(id, init)` / `ui.use_state_named_default::<T>(id)` — id-keyed local state, safe inside conditionals
- `.with_if(cond, modifier)` / `.with(modifier)` — fluent conditional styling on text and `ContainerBuilder`

### Current (v0.25) highlights

- Scroll containers follow keyboard focus (nested axes, modal forms, resize); opt out per container with the public `ScrollState::follow_focus` field (default `true`)
- `ui.form_field_response(&mut field)` returns `FormFieldResponse`; `ui.focused_layout_rect()` / `ui.measured_layout_rect(name)` expose full previous-frame geometry
- Input typed after a Tab in the same batch is queued for the next frame; custom loops can check `AppState::has_pending_input()` / `TestBackend::has_pending_input()`
- Quick transitions: `ui.animate_bool(id, on)` / `ui.animate_value(id, target, ticks)` — see [Animation](ANIMATION.md)

### Longer-standing helpers

- `NO_COLOR` env var support (auto-disables color output when set)
- `scroll_col` — vertical scroll container helper
- `container().draw_with(data, |buf, rect, data| { ... })` — raw draw with owned data
- `Buffer::try_get(x, y) -> Option<&Cell>` — fallible buffer cell accessor for `draw(|buf, rect| ...)` raw-draw closures

### Builder widgets

- `ui.breadcrumb(segments).separator(...).show()` — returns `BreadcrumbResponse` with the standard interaction signals and `clicked_segment`
- `mx(n)` / `my(n)` — horizontal / vertical margin shorthands

## Specialized topics

- [Theming](THEMING.md): 10 preset themes, ThemeColor semantic tokens, WidgetColors overrides, Tailwind palette
- [Animation](ANIMATION.md): animate_bool / animate_value quick transitions; Tween, Spring, Keyframes, Sequence, Stagger
- [Backends](BACKENDS.md): custom backends, Backend trait, AppState, frame()
- [Testing](TESTING.md): TestBackend, EventBuilder
- [Debugging](DEBUGGING.md): F12 overlay, clipping issues, focus surprises
- [Features](FEATURES.md): feature flags (crossterm, async, serde, image, qrcode, syntax)

## Examples

Runnable targets (`cargo run --example <name>`; `autoexamples = false`, so other file names in `examples/` are not runnable):

- `hello` ([source](../examples/hello.rs)): smallest app
- `counter` ([source](../examples/counter.rs)): state plus keyboard
- `demo` ([source](../examples/demo.rs)): broad widget tour
- `cookbook_tour` ([source](../examples/cookbook_tour.rs)): the COOKBOOK recipes as tabs
- `interaction_tour` ([source](../examples/interaction_tour.rs)): click / double-click / scroll `Response` signals, `KeyMap`, focus traversal
- `showcase_tour` ([source](../examples/showcase_tour.rs)): dashboard, infoviz, website, spreadsheet, trading screens
- `text_tour` ([source](../examples/text_tour.rs)): CJK, IME, CLI-style text
- `system_tour --features async` ([source](../examples/system_tour.rs)): error boundary, overlay anchor, async / inline modes
- `widgets_tour` ([source](../examples/widgets_tour.rs)): hooks, theming, modal focus traps, layout helpers as tabs
- `inline` ([source](../examples/inline.rs)): `run_inline` below the shell prompt
- `async_demo --features async` ([source](../examples/async_demo.rs)): `run_async` with a tokio producer

Source modules shown inside tours (read them, run the tour):

- [examples/demo_dashboard.rs](../examples/demo_dashboard.rs): dashboard composition — `showcase_tour`
- [examples/demo_infoviz.rs](../examples/demo_infoviz.rs): charts and visualizations — `showcase_tour`
- [examples/demo_website.rs](../examples/demo_website.rs): canonical `provide` / `use_context` composition — `showcase_tour`
- [examples/demo_cli.rs](../examples/demo_cli.rs): CLI-style layout — `text_tour`
- [examples/demo_cjk.rs](../examples/demo_cjk.rs): CJK / wide-character rendering, title clamp, mouse hover — `text_tour`
